_published_faq.name: How do I add Third Bridge to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Third Bridge to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://ai.thirdbridge.com/mcp/sse. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

acceptedAnswer.text: Third Bridge provides these MCP tools: third_bridge_content_query.

_published_faq.name: Does Third Bridge MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Third Bridge requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Third Bridge is developed by Third Bridge Group. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
